overview.description: The Tradr 2X Long SpaceX Daily ETF (SPCM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in communication services equity. The fund provides 2x exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement for shares of Space Exploration Technologies Corporation (NASDAQ: SPCX) stock. SPCM was launched on Jun 12, 2026 and is issued by Tradr.
